display.title: {"text": "The Deep (Otherside & Undergarden)"}
description: Ancient Cities, Deeper and Darker's Otherside temples and the Undergarden's catacombs and camps. Sound and darkness matter.
&ePrepare:&r Swift Sneak, night vision, wool to muffle steps, a plan for the Warden.
&eSignature rewards:&r Echoing Fossils (exchange for Breach/Guardian gems), Ancient Cores, ancient-city hearts (rare), Warden carapace (upstream).
&eComing back:&r Each Ancient City and Otherside temple is a one-time clear; the Undergarden is a self-contained dimension.
&eFeeds into:&r Fossils -> armour-piercing/defence gems; cores -> sockets.
&aObjective:&r Step inside any structure of this family.
&bWhy it matters:&r Knowing what a family offers before you go makes the trip worth it.
